notes.title: Have You Played… Paunch?
notes.notes:
Have You Played? is an endless stream of game retrospectives. One a day, every day, perhaps for all time.

Paunch

is tagged “Psychological Horror” and “Sexual Content” on Steam, and while this is wrong, it also couldn’t be more accurate. Two players take control of huge sumo wrestlers called Bob and fight to the death by flinging large rocks at each other. One can also opt to charge down the opposing player and lay them out with a solid hook to the chin. It is immediately arousing, yet disquieting.
(more…)

notes.title: Empty Boulder Update: Challenges and Achievements
notes.notes:
Bob's life was unpredictable, but blissful. What he found in the arena was a revelation.

[b]White Boulder[/b]

A 13th empty boulder has appeared in the arena. This white container is not like the rest: it contains no life, and a hit with it ends the character’s lifecycle.

[b]Daily challenges[/b]

To make the season go by faster and discover the possibilities of the game, complete daily challenges. Each challenge contains a counter for the required value and a limit that cannot be exceeded. Every day you can earn a reward for a single challenge; if you don’t like it or it proves too challenging you can replace it up to two times.

[b]Final screen[/b]

HITS - points from hit
KNOCKOUTS - points from hand-to-hand attack
COUNTERBLOWS - extra points from similar reply attack
SCORING BEGUN - extra 2 points for first hit/knockout

[b]Leaderboard[/b]

In the PROGRESS tab, you will see a leaderboard. 
Currently in test mode, ranking and requirements will be announced later.

[b]Achievements[/b]

The game now has 15 achievements.

notes.title: Quarter million and "no contest"
notes.notes:
Less than month we reached 250000 lifetime unique players, many boulders destroyed. 
And this is just beginning.

[b]no contest[/b]
Connecting players from different regions is difficult to predict network latency. But you can quickly finish combat without decision. If you see red ping (600+), use "Back" button (Escape by default). No more pain.

[b]future[/b]
Challenges, statistics, achievements, and more at the beginning of 2020.
